text:
anna: starting RC creation for service-api -> rc-2026-03-21. pinning artifact sha=abcdef12345 to candidate. requesting quick smoke and kv-warm before staging promo.
kevin: ack. will run smoke now. can we do a 5m quiet window after canary lift?
mia: doing quick e2e smoke in staging (tests: sanity, auth, kv). ETA ~6m.
ci-bot: build/packager pipeline #789 finished — STATUS: SUCCESS — artifacts at https://ci.internal/redwood/service-api/abcdef12345 :white_check_mark:
deploybot: staged deploy created: candidate=rc-2026-03-21, env=staging, task=deploy-345 — KV warm enabled, preflight checks queued.
anna: note: pin in release notes draft: https://docs.internal/releases/rc-2026-03-21.md — please add any customer-impacting deltas.
kevin: smoke results: auth OK, basic endpoints OK, latency within SLO for 95p. found one flaky test (rate-limit) — retrying.
mia: KV warm done (redis primed). starting canary rollout to 5% traffic for 10m.
deploybot: traffic split applied -> 5% canary for rc-2026-03-21. monitor for errors and latency regressions.
ops-sheriff: I'll watch telemetry (errors, 5xx, p99). set alert if >0.5% error delta or p99 +50ms.
kevin: looks clean so far. no obvious error spikes.
anna: decision needed: promote to prod after 10m hold if no regressions. any objections?
kevin: no objections. recommend promoting with a staged 25/50/100 over 30m window.
mia: +1. prepare rollback plan and notify on-call.
ops-sheriff: on-call aware. creating incident channel in case.
anna: adding rollback steps to the thread:
kevin: rollback command (one-liner):
```
# rollback to previous pinned sha
./scripts/deploy --service service-api --env prod --pin sha=abcdef01234 --wait
```
kevin: note: previous sha=abcdef01234 passed canary 03/20 and has been proven in prod.
ci-bot: pre-promo checklist: unit tests ✅, integration smoke ✅, kv warm ✅, metrics queries validated ✅.
deploybot: requesting promo window approval: protected change window 22:00-23:59 UTC? this RC will be promoted during that window if approved.
anna: approved for the 22:00-23:59 UTC change window. will start staged promo at 22:05 UTC.
mia: adding release-notes short summary: "Service API: improve routing latency, fix header parsing bug. Backwards compatible."
kevin: tagging owners for post-promo monitoring: @platform-observability, @ingest-team.
ops-sheriff: setting a 30m telemetry gate post-100% promo. abort criteria: >0.5% error delta OR p99 +100ms OR saturation >85% on any serving node.
kevin: if abort triggered run rollback command above and run quick traffic reroute to fallback cluster.
anna: final call at 22:00 UTC. if anyone raises a red flag before then speak now. otherwise exec plan. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
mia: all good from my side. prepping canary escalation notes.
kevin: prepping post-promo smoke script so we can validate prod quickly.
deploybot: note — when promotion runs it will record audit entry and notify #release-notifications channel.
anna: thanks team — will post back here once promo kicks off and after post-promo readout. :rocket:
